elsewhere.note: When Solomon had finished the building of Yahweh’s house, the king’s house, and all Solomon’s desire which he was pleased to do,
and Baalath, and all the storage cities that Solomon had, and all the cities for his chariots, the cities for his horsemen, and all that Solomon desired to…
My heart flutters. Horror has frightened me. The twilight that I desired has been turned into trembling for me.
